text:
leah - Sales: ACME POC: hybrid setup (hosted inference + private agent in their VPC). They've uploaded a SIG/CAIQ and marked DPA redlines. Ask: 1) exactly what telemetry/usage leaves a private deployment by default, 2) can we commit to a 14-day POC retention and a verified deletion workflow, and 3) quick POC cost for 2x A10G-equivalent dedicated nodes (hourly). They want answers by EOD Thu. Who can own each piece?

omar - Security: I can own the SIG controls mapping. Short summary: private agent -> no raw prompts/responses exfiltrated by default; agent sends a small heartbeat + optional aggregated counters. Hosted = full telemetry to Redwood. Need the SIG link to map control IDs.

leah - Sales: Uploaded partial SIG here: https://acme.example/sig-partial (DM for full). They specifically called out: "prompt/response logging in private", "telemetry fields", and "DSAR delete proofs".

chen - Legal: For the DPA: we can sign a 14-day retention addendum for a time-boxed POC. On DSARs: customer is the data controller for private deployments; Redwood will provide exports and a deletion tool + attestation cert if requested. I'll draft the addendum and a short attestation template. :writing_hand:

natalie - Eng Platform: Private agent default telemetry payload (no PII): {"heartbeat_ts", "node_id", "gpu_stats", "process_uptime", "metric_counts_agg"}. We never ship prompt/response text off-host unless `enable_usage_reporting: true`. If they flip that, only token counts (hashed) are sent, not raw text. Example agent config they can apply: ```yaml
agent.telemetry:
  enable_usage_reporting: false
  heartbeat_interval_s: 60
  telemetry_retention_days: 14
```

omar - Security: Also note network egress policy: we support strict egress ACLs so the agent only talks to configured endpoints (control plane) over TLS 1.2+. For SIG mapping I'll produce a table mapping their CAIQ control IDs -> our control statements (will show encryption at rest, KMS bind, RBAC, logging controls).

sam - Solutions: Pricing quick take: POC hourly for 2 A10G equiv nodes = $X/hr/node (DMing exact figure). Minimum POC booking: 1 week billing unless they use hosted credits. Estimated token spend for a moderate workload (~200k tokens/day) roughly $Y/day hosted. If they want a 14-day flat quote we can give a not-to-exceed estimate.

leah - Sales: Action: @omar - SIG mapping + statement on prompt logging, @chen - 14d addendum + attestation template, @natalie - paste exact agent config & delete commands, @sam - send POC hourly + 14-day estimate. I'll combine and send back to ACME.

natalie - Eng Platform: DSAR / deletion recommended flow for private: `1) owner runs: redwood-admin export --subject <email> --out subject-data.json` then `2) after review: redwood-admin scrub --subject <email> --confirm > scrub-report.txt`. We can produce an HMAC-signed deletion attestation file for legal. Also note we require admin RBAC role to run these.

omar - Security: Confirming: default private behavior = no prompt/response logging off-host. If they request additional diagnostics we require explicit consent in config and it will be scoped/hashed. I'll upload the SIG answer doc by EOD.

chen - Legal: Drafting the 14d addendum now. Will include: retention window, deletion attestation, SCCs note (if cross-border), and confirmation that customer is controller for PII in private deployment. Upload in ~3h.

sam - Solutions: Sent DM with preliminary hourly numbers + 14-day T&E. Note: POC discounts available but require approval from finance for anything under X% margin.

leah - Sales: Great. If anyone hits a blocker call it out here and Ill escalate. Will wait for the addendum + SIG table + config snippet before replying to ACME.
